data.name: Dara
data.gender_notes: Dara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dara is derived from the Arabic word 'dairah' which means 'subtlety', 'gentleness', and 'softness'. It is also believed to mean 'a place of refuge' and 'a source of light'. The name Dara carries the meaning “Gentle, Soft, Subtle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Dara usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft, subtle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dara is a name of great spiritual significance in Islam. It is believed to symbolize the gentle and nurturing qualities of Allah, and is often given to girls born into families who seek to raise them with love, care, and compassion.
data.etymology: Dara belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Soft, Subtle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dara total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
